name: SkillSphere
tagline: AI-powered proof-of-work skill verification, intelligent squad matching, and dynamic career roadmaps for students.
description: A next-generation talent and collaboration platform replacing generic resume claims with verified proof-of-work. Features Google Gemini-powered GitHub multi-stack repository analysis, the Antifragile N.E.X.U.S. matching engine, skill-gated project squads, and real-time Socket.io communication.
highlights: Gameproof multi-stack repository verification powered by Google Gemini AI
Antifragile N.E.X.U.S. multi-strategy consensus matching engine
Skill-gated project squads with automated background lifecycle maintenance

name: Opendoor
tagline: Digital hostel management & gate pass platform for university campuses.
leadBuilder: KSHITIZ, HARSHIT SINGH, HARSH KASAUNDHAN, ARYAN GUPTA
description: Full-stack hostel management system with digital gate passes, QR-JWT scanning, concurrency-safe bed booking, payment processing, and real-time Socket.io updates. Currently in active prototype development.

name: Intelli-Light 3.0
tagline: Universal Adaptive Traffic Signal Control using Spatio-Temporal MARL (GAT+LSTM), SUMO, and NTCIP 1202 Failsafes.
description: Autonomous multi-agent adaptive traffic signal control system for chaotic urban grids. Replaces rigid grid arrays with topology-agnostic Graph Attention Networks (GAT) and LSTM temporal sequence memory, combining exponential anti-starvation reward engineering with deterministic NTCIP 1202 SNMP hardware failsafe watchdogs.
highlights: Topology-agnostic Spatio-Temporal MARL model coordinating variable-degree intersections (3-way, 4-way, 5-way)
Multi-factor production reward engine with exponential anti-starvation penalty and green-wave bonus
Deterministic Failsafe Watchdog with NTCIP 1202 SNMP hardware cabinet integration for zero-risk municipal deployment

name: Sentinel
tagline: City-Wide Multi-Camera ANPR Trajectory Tracking, Congestion-Aware Anomaly Scoring & Tactical Traffic Intercept.
description: City-wide autonomous urban surveillance and traffic intercept platform. Ingests distributed ANPR camera feeds, resolves OCR noise via multi-frame consensus voting with fuzzy confusion tolerance, reconstructs road-snapped vehicle paths, detects evasive behavior using live GNN congestion telemetry, and provides closed-loop traffic intercept orchestration with emergency vehicle preemption.
highlights: Multi-frame consensus OCR voter with RapidFuzz confusion pair tolerance (0/D, 1/I, 8/B, 5/S)
Kinematic plausibility watchdog (v <= 30 m/s) with real road network polyline snapping (RoadSnapper)
GNN congestion-aware anomaly scorer that cross-references route deviation with real-time queue lengths
Tactical red-wall intercept orchestrator with emergency vehicle preemption (EVP) and SHA-256 hash-chained audit logging
